artifact.name: Marketplace Operator
artifact.summary: Plans marketplace releases, checks publish readiness, and prepares audit-friendly rollout notes.
artifact.description_md: Marketplace Operator is an AnyClaw agent for running a small cloud marketplace safely. It helps maintain artifact metadata, review release notes, verify risk and permission declarations, and prepare publish or quarantine actions for an administrator to approve.

versions.changelog_md: Initial Marketplace Operator agent for release planning, metadata review, and audit-oriented marketplace operations.
